title: How Well Can LLMs Echo Us? Evaluating AI Chatbots’ Role-Play Ability with ECHO

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the evaluation accuracy of LLMs when explicitly instructed to select human-generated responses versus when instructed to select machine-generated responses to see if the models inherently favor a specific instruction type or their own generated text.

Creating a Control Model that always selects the longer answer and comparing its selection success rate against the evaluator LLMs to investigate if the models have a disproportionate preference for lengthier responses.

Randomizing the presentation order of the answers (Answer 0 and Answer 1) within each question-answer pair and conducting multiple rounds of evaluation to prevent and assess preferences based purely on the order of choices.
